column1: # ApplyLabelSpec.java spec for /C132E0278.fullbin (2026-11-03): globals of obd_ii_update_states().
# The function runs the MIL flash pattern, warm-up / drive-cycle detection, distance counters, dispatches the
# OBD monitors by obd_ii_monitor_task_scheduler_token bit (100 ms tokens), and rotates through the current /
# confirmed / pending / permanent DTC lists, one code per list every 10 calls, as 5-char text + raw + decimal.
# obd_ii_dtc_unpack(): decimal DTC = letter*10000 (P=0, C=1, B=2, U=3) + the 4 BCD digits (P0171 -> 171).

column5: MIL state: bit0/1 MIL requested (either -> mode 01 MIL bit), bit2 flash request, bit3 MIL lamp output (toggled every 5 x 100 ms to flash; read by the cluster), bit4 distance-with-MIL counting, bit5 DTC event timer active, bit6 secondary lamp (cluster). Was obd_ii_montior_passes_bitfield.
100 ms ticks in the MIL flash cycle (toggle every 5; 29/30 for the readiness-display pattern at key-on).
Byte 2 of CAN 0x250 from the IPS TCU: bit0 = request MIL on, bit1 = request the secondary lamp (IPS-coded cars only); zeroed on CAN timeout.
1 once this drive cycle has been counted in obd_ii_warmups_since_code_cleared.
1 when the drive-cycle timers below have all expired (runtime, time above speed, idle time); enables DTC aging in mode 01 processing.
Countdown of engine running time (CAL_obd_ii_drive_cycle_runtime).
Countdown of time at or above CAL_obd_ii_drive_cycle_car_speed_min (CAL_obd_ii_gd_speed_time).
Countdown of continuous idle time (CAL_obd_ii_drive_cycle_idle_time); reloaded if moving with rpm above the idle target by CAL_obd_ii_monitor_rpm_delta_max.
Idle target rpm without dashpot / car-speed / pedal adders (idle()); used for rpm-above-idle tests.
Sub-km accumulator for obd_ii_distance_since_codes_cleared_km: += car_speed_x100/360 per 100 ms (10 cm units); at 10000 (1 km) the km counter increments.
